title: Dual arm peg-in-hole force/torque values during contact
author: David Ortega (Mendeley creator; profile display name David Ortega-Aranda)
derived_tables_license: CC BY 4.0; attribution David Ortega. Modified by deriving per-sensor force/moment magnitudes and class frequencies.
unit_of_observation: One row corresponds to one published example. Index resets for the second file. No time or trial ID in either CSV.
known_limitations: Source metadata describes eight concentric misalignment/contact-state classes. The numeric labels do not establish an independent external contact-wrench or wrist-bias ground truth.

Physical units, frame alignment, per-axis calibration, per-sample contact timing and individual run boundaries are absent from the two CSV headers and publisher description. Magnitudes use native units.
No exact full-vector overlap between splits was found. Independence across time, trials and workpieces cannot be established.
method: Within each sensor compute Euclidean magnitudes independently for three f axes and three m axes. Preserve official split, original zero-based row index and label y. No filtering, fitting, coordinate transformation or cross-sensor summation.
